newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Scancem buys 25 pct of Indian cement firm.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Scancem buys 25 pct of Indian cement firm.

text.p: Cement company Scancem said on Tuesday its subsidiary Scancem International bought 25 percent of the shares in an Indian cement company, Narmada Cement Company Ltd.
Scancem said in a statement it carried out the purchase through a share issue and that it was subject to approval by Indian authorities.

Narmada plans to increase capacity to three million tonnes from 1.2 million tonnes through investments of up to $150 million with support from Scancem. The company's main owner is India's Chowgule Group, Scancem said.
At the same time it said together with international partners it was investing 200 million crowns in cement facilities in Bangladesh.
The investments in Bangladesh involve equipment and a ship to transport cement.
"Our goal is to acquire a significant market share (in Bangladesh) and to further develop our operations," it said.
The two deals will only marginally affect Scancem's key ratios, Scancem said.
